inputMethod: Queued synthetic XR controller/HMD states in the normal Dynamic input update; production Input Actions, ray interactors and saved LanguageButton selectEntered handlers. No SelectEnter/SelectExit or TriggerProgrammatically calls. The existing simulator device writer is temporarily disabled.
limitations: XR controller poses are automated fixtures, not physical headset/controller, reachability or OS keyboard/mouse simulator testing. Demonstration start/stop uses the public exploration API and is labelled separately. Hidden labels are enabled only in a temporary Play Mode lifecycle fixture, then restored. PNGs are monocular captures: production view and separately labelled fixed diagnostic close-ups. No comfort, user study, historical accuracy or executable build claim.
